designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Cypress Creek National Wildlife Refuge under the Emergency Wetlands Resources Act to protect southern Illinois wetlands.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Cypress Creek National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Recreational Fishing Plan : Cypress Creek National Wildlife Refuge (ServCat 7128): "Cypress Creek National Wildlife Refuge (NWR) was established on June 26, 1990 under the Emergency Wetlands Resources Act of 1986"
